sections.description:
A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum.

blocks.title: Social
blocks.body: - Players can now set their social status to Online, Away, Busy, or Appear Offline (Note: appearing offline does not prevent friends from seeing you if you are placed into the same match). This option can be found under the social menu

sections.title: HERO UPDATES
sections.description:
This method makes Resurrect more flexible when used with Valkyrie. For example, in the past if you wanted to resurrect two teammates, you had to revive the first target, then activate Valkyrie (causing the Resurrect’s cooldown to reset), and then revive the other target. With this change, you can now activate Valkyrie and fly in quickly to resurrect both targets instantly.

However, this still reduces the overall number of Resurrects that Mercy can provide, since Valkyrie no longer reduces its cooldown.

heroes.dev_note: A recent bug fix slowed Lúcio’s Wall Ride. This change compensates for the reduced speed.

changes.text_en: The speed boost that Lúcio receives after completing a wall ride has been increased by 65%

heroes.dev_note: Valkyrie no longer resets or reduces Resurrect’s cooldown. Instead, it now provides an extra 'charge,' allowing you to revive an ally even if it is still on cooldown. If the bonus charge hasn’t been spent when Valkyrie ends, it will be removed.

changes.text_en: Players can now glide past a targeted ally using the jump key
Cooldown no longer resets when Resurrect is activated
No longer resets or reduces Resurrection’s cooldown
Now gives players a bonus resurrection charge

general.text_en: Added a number of additional voicelines for Cultist Zenyatta
